main_idea: A benchmark built with Legora raised production output quality 5% in one month.
ideas: AfterQuery and Legora built BAR, a legal agent benchmark
BAR tests end-to-end legal work inside Legora's harness
Benchmark-informed harness changes raised output quality 5%
summary: The +5% result is the main visual but is buried among a dataset stats row, a three-step process row, a slogan headline, a kicker and a footer tagline; the graphic lacks nothing needed to read the claim.
